structured_output.rationale: All three lines carry OA-22 ($183.72 total, $0 paid). The 271 for DOS 2026-02-01 returns EB*R identifying Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B FFS as an additional payer with MSG "PLAN IS PRIMARY PAYER FOR THIS MEMBER," while the 837P was submitted SBR*P (primary) to Keystone. COB order is inverted. MA04 at claim level corroborates missing primary adjudication data. Bill Medicare first, then rebill Keystone secondary.

root_cause.explanation: Claim billed to Keystone as primary (SBR*P/CI). 271 EB*R names Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B FFS as primary payer for this member on DOS 2026-02-01. OA-22 on all three lines confirms wrong COB order.

next_action.detail: Submit a new 837P (CLM05-3=1) to Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B (NPI/payer ID 1846349352) as primary. After Medicare adjudicates, rebill Keystone as secondary with Medicare's SBR/AMT/CAS adjudication data populated to avoid MA04.
